This 0.10 ha plot is small but important to me. I have some schooling and I know that maize does well with fertilizer, so I will buy a small amount of DAP and urea from the cooperative—maybe 10 kg of each for this plot, which is what I can afford. I also have some cattle manure that I will mix in because the soil benefits from it. I will plant an improved maize variety since I am already investing in fertilizer, and I want a good yield from this little piece of land. I do not have irrigation and I do not see the need for chemicals against pests on maize, so I will skip those. My family can manage the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves on this small plot, so I will not hire help.
